title: RealHeights
description: Allow players to be their actual height in Minecraft!
body:
![Two people with different heights](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b10befbcc45c889da9545884c62e536675b9b6e7.png)
 ​
> RealHeights is a lightweight and intuitive plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ that allows players to change their character's
height using real-world units. Whether you prefer the Metric or Imperial system, RealHeights has you covered!

✨ Features:
- Multi-Unit Support: Set your height using cm, m, ft, or feet'inches.
- Safety Limits: Admins can set minimum and maximum height limits in the config.
- Fully Configurable: Customize all messages and default values.

Commands:
- /height <value> - Set your height (e.g., 185cm, 1.85m, 6'1, or 6ft).
- /height reset - Revert to the standard Minecraft height.
- /height reload - Reload the plugin configuration.

Permissions:
- realheights.use - Allows players to change their height (Default: true).
- realheights.reload - Allows reloading the config (Default: OP).
  
⚙️ Configuration:
```
min-height: 110
max-height: 250
default-height: 180 # Standard MC height
```
